explanation: Soprano comes from the Italian sopra, 'above'. Alto, the next part down, comes from the Latin altus, 'high', because it was once the high part above the tenor.

claims.text: Of the four standard choir parts (soprano, alto, tenor and bass), soprano is the highest.
Alto, tenor and bass are the three lower parts of a four-part choir.
'Soprano' comes from the Italian sopra, meaning above.
'Alto' comes from the Latin altus, high, from its early role as a part above the tenor.
